split_policy: development-only cohort; twelve new scenario families; five tasks per family; thirty answerable and thirty unanswerable tasks

provenance.authoring_method: Prompt draft independently labeled against pinned parser-v4 source pages and exact SQLite example IDs; native-shell ambiguities clarified before retrieval.
provenance.scope: development-only; no holdout files, reports, prior retrieval outcomes, or candidate output inspected; no retrieval run during labeling.

platform_ambiguity: Platform follows corpus selection: common uses common pages; linux/osx/windows use native pages with common fallback. Windows questions explicitly request built-in Command Prompt commands or PowerShell cmdlets to exclude unrelated common utilities.
